entities.name: Labarna I
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Labarna was the traditional first king of the Hittites, c. early 17th century BC, the most accepted chronology nowadays. He was the traditional founder of the Hittite Old Kingdom. His wife was Tawannanna.
